newsitem.title: FRANCE: France seen turning dry again by mid-week.
newsitem.headline: France seen turning dry again by mid-week.

text.p: Light rain was seen lingering over eastern France on Monday and Tuesday, but forecasters said dry weather was expected to return by mid-week.
"The weather is set to turn dry again on Wednesday and this could last until Saturday," a Meteo France forecaster said.
Meteo France said an estimated 10 mm fell across France over the weekend, bringing parched crops some relief after a three-month dry spell.
A further 3-5 mm was forecast for eastern France on Monday, and scattered showers were also expected in the southwest.
In the Beauce grain belt, weekend rain was heavier than expected, reaching 20 mm.
"This did the crops some good, although this is not sufficient to replenish water tables," the forecaster said.
